subject.title: [Feature]: Pattern-based channel allowlist for Discord (glob/wildcard support)

question: Should Discord guild allowlists accept a pattern grammar such as `ws-*`, and what precedence should it have relative to exact id/name/slug, thread-parent, and literal `*` entries?
rationale: Pattern matching changes which Discord channels may trigger agents, so implementation cannot safely choose the authorization grammar or conflict resolution unilaterally.

options.title: Adopt a narrow glob contract
options.body: Support a documented limited pattern form after exact and parent matches but before the literal `*` fallback, with deterministic conflict ordering and tests.

options.title: Keep exact-only authorization
options.body: Retain the current explicit channel-entry model and direct dynamic-channel workflows to category-level configuration or operational automation.

options.title: Design one combined hierarchy
options.body: Coordinate this request with category and broader access-list proposals before adding any new matching grammar.

recommendation.title: Adopt a narrow glob contract
recommendation.body: Support a documented limited pattern form after exact and parent matches but before the literal `*` fallback, with deterministic conflict ordering and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied feature history places this person on the shared matcher and affected Discord allowlist path.
